# O2BUCAK — Ersin ÖZBUCAK

O2BUCAK is the personal website of Ersin ÖZBUCAK, an IT Systems & Infrastructure professional. The site documents his experience, Enterprise Reference Architecture project, certifications and training, personal technology projects, and current areas of learning including Linux, open-source infrastructure, automation, cloud and AI infrastructure.
